The left rock slab has some flatter mid-slate areas, and the 16% near-flat coverage points to a few larger flat regions. The raw count of only 19 distinct colours also shows a limited ramp compared with the grass reference's 80. By eye, the left slab and the right columns carry less grain than the best reference tiles. Overall it is close but slightly lower in richness, and it is borderline, so I lean to fail given the instruction to fail when in doubt.
